summary: Process exhibits unverified digital signature and unusual parent process relationship.

observed_facts.text: The executable is located in a standard Windows directory but lacks a valid digital signature.
The SHA-256 hash was computed over 4096 bytes and does not match known Windows OS components.

hypotheses.text: Potentially an unsigned third-party maintenance utility or modified system tool.

benign_explanations: Legitimate developer tool or locally built administrative utility without digital signature.
missing_evidence: network_activity: Connection monitoring was disabled or unavailable during collection.

recommended_actions.reason: Allows analyst to check executable SHA-256 against threat intelligence feeds.
Inspect surrounding directory contents and file properties in File Explorer.

uncertainty_notes: Absence of network activity data prevents confirming beaconing or C2 communication.
